posts.post: I'm debating between heavyweight cotton or a custom performance blend for the next drop. Convince me why I'm wrong if I stick with the heavy cotton.
Most guys think they need a massive wardrobe to look good. You really only need three perfect pieces that actually fit. What is one item in your closet that never fails you.
Building a brand from the ground up is 90 percent stress and 10 percent actually seeing the design come to life. The people who say it's easy are selling you a course.
